_comment: The Scapify Method: an 8-step filter for translating any game concept into an Aelgard-native design. Ported from /tmp/scape-repos/ScapifyDatSheet/SCAPIFY.md. The builder AI can feed this JSON to Claude alongside a raw idea to produce a structured design spec in the same shape as existing minigames, bosses, and raids. Steps 1 through 8 MUST be satisfied in order; if a step breaks the idea, do not skip -- rethink.

steps.name: Strip to the Core Loop
steps.instruction: Remove IP, graphics, platform. Write one sentence: 'The player does X to achieve Y under constraint Z.'

steps.name: Translate to Point-and-Click
steps.instruction: Rewrite so it works with mouse and tick-based (0.6s) timing. Replace twitch mechanics with decision-making under pressure: prayer switching, gear swaps, tile positioning, resource management.

steps.name: Hook Into the Skill System
steps.instruction: Define entry requirements (skills + quests), skill integration DURING play, and XP rewards. Never make it BIS XP/hr.

steps.name: Design the Grind
steps.instruction: Define currency + shop + unique drops + pet + collection log slots. Reward must justify repetition but not devalue existing content. Pet drop sweet spot 1/3000-1/5000.

steps.name: Add Stakes
steps.instruction: Define death mechanics, entry cost, failure penalty, scaling pressure. Even safe content needs opportunity cost or time investment.

steps.name: Shape the Social Model
steps.instruction: Define team size, matchmaking, role differentiation, carry potential, social friction. This decides long-term health.

output.social_friction: how hard to start a game

steps.name: Find the Cousin
steps.instruction: Name 1-3 existing Aelgard/OSRS pieces that share DNA. Explain shared DNA and divergence. No cousin = not Aelgard-native; revisit 2-3.

steps.name: Name It Like Jagex Would
steps.instruction: Short, punchy, wordplay or alliteration or medieval/fantasy flavour. Never reference source material directly. Good: 'Soul Wars', 'Tempoross', 'Guardians of the Rift'. Bad: 'MOBA Arena', 'Zombie Survival Mode'.

output_schema.rewards: object with currency, shop, uniques, pet, completionist
output_schema.stakes: object with death, entry, failure, scaling

pass_criteria.cousin_exists: must name at least 1 existing piece of content that shares DNA
pass_criteria.skill_integrated: at least one skill used DURING play, not just to enter
pass_criteria.reward_non_devaluing: unique drops fill gaps, do not replace existing BIS
pass_criteria.scaling_pressure_defined: how difficulty ramps must be explicit
pass_criteria.named_like_jagex: name passes the 'teleport list' test - would a player click it
